changeSet.comment: Update temperature concept to allow decimal values
changeSet.sql: UPDATE concept_numeric SET allow_decimal = 1 WHERE concept_id = ( SELECT DISTINCT concept_id FROM concept_name WHERE name = 'Temperature' AND voided = 0 );
